tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and input background, the lightest surface. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Panels, sidebars, menus, message bubbles, modals and anything raised one step above paper. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text, every frame and rule, and solid buttons. It is the text colour on paper, cream and tint, and on the ink and green leads it flips to cream so it stays the one text colour.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Soft accent fill: the open dropdown, the chosen option, the hover on a tab. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: g1
tokens.usage: The accent (PMC green). Focus ring, switch on, primary hover fill, assistant rule, scrollbar thumb, dialog title bar, slider fill. Text on it is cream (4.2:1 on the cream lead: display-face labels only, never running text). Anyone can replace it with their own accent; g2, g3 and tint are then derived from it.

tokens.name: g2
tokens.usage: Accent dark: the hard shadow under buttons, plates, menus and dialogs, and the code block header strip. Derived from the accent as g1 mixed 42% toward black. Text on it is cream (8.2:1).

tokens.name: g3
tokens.usage: Accent light, g1 mixed 42% toward white. Link and tick colour on the dark ink and green pages. Never a fill behind text.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Highlight. Text selection (with ink text), the slider handle, the keyboard ring inside a segmented bar, scrollbar hover and the flash outline around a message. Never a text colour. On the gold lead it equals the page, so those marks take ink there.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, stop and delete, and the unlit state of a status chip. As text it is 6.1:1 on paper (cream lead); on the gold lead it is 3.1:1 on paper, so use it there only for the left bar and icons. Fills with danger take white or cream text.

families.display: 'PMC Symbols L2', 'PMC Header', 'Shoulders', 'Arial Narrow', Impact, sans-serif
families.text: 'PMC Symbols L4 Upright', 'PMC Symbols L4', 'PMC Font Upright', 'PMC Font', 'Plex', 'Courier New', monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: h1: clamp(2.6rem, 6.4vw, 6rem). One per page, in a title block.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Plate titles: clamp(1.2rem, 1.7vw, 1.6rem). Dialog titles are 2rem.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: h3. The chat title in the top bar is 1.5rem.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons: 1.1rem, primary 1.25rem, small 0.95rem. Tabs, segmented bars and dropdown buttons sit at 1.02-1.12rem.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small headings over a value, 80% opacity. Switch and slider labels are 1.1rem.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Page text, 1.05rem on a 13.5px root. Paragraphs stop at 66ch.

styles.name: hint
styles.sample: Only used to check this address.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline code. Programming ligatures on.

spacing.note: Coe has no spacing scale. These are the steps its CSS actually uses; stay on them.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hard-shadow offset at rest, tight gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control, between icon and label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding (10-12px), chip gaps, small panel padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button side padding, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog body and composer padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between messages.

tokens.name: square
tokens.usage: Every box, button, input, tag, menu, scrollbar and switch. The only corner shape is a square one. Do not add radius.

shadow.note: Hard offset shadows with zero blur. They grow on hover and shrink when pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-btn
tokens.usage: Resting button, tab and chip shadow. Three pixels right and down, no blur. Small buttons use 2px.

tokens.name: shadow-btn-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on a button: the shadow grows by two pixels and the fill flips to ink.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state of buttons and plates: the shadow shrinks as the button is pushed in.

tokens.name: shadow-plate
tokens.usage: Plates (tiles), toasts and the code block header strip. On the c1 plate the shadow is the accent.

tokens.name: shadow-plate-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on a plate.

tokens.name: shadow-bubble
tokens.usage: Message bubbles, in the accent. The assistant bubble and the user bubble both use it.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: A focused text field: its shadow appears, in the accent.

tokens.name: shadow-ink
tokens.usage: Segmented bar and dropdown button. These two take their shadow in ink, not green, so they read as one control with the field beside them.

tokens.name: shadow-ink-sm
tokens.usage: Switch track, slider handle, tabs and small dropdowns, in ink.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Popovers and dropdown lists. Two steps above a plate, so an open menu sits on top of the page.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs. The largest shadow in the system; nothing is bigger.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Frame on inputs, plates, menus, dropdowns, segmented bars, tabs and switches.

tokens.name: frame-heavy
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their title bar rule, the sidebar divider, and the focus ring.

tokens.name: frame-thin
tokens.usage: Buttons (all sizes), message bubbles, code blocks, chips, meters, table lines.
